questions: Should the function raise TypeError if any column is non-numeric, or only if all columns are non-numeric?
Should the normalization be applied per column independently (MinMaxScaler default axis=0) or globally across all columns?
If a column's cumulative sum is constant (e.g., all zeros), should the normalized output be all zeros or handle division by zero (e.g., keep zeros or raise error)?
Should the output DataFrame have the same index as the input DataFrame, or a default integer index?
Are integer dtypes allowed, or must all columns be float? Should the output dtype be float regardless of input dtype?
Should the function preserve the order of columns exactly as input, or is any permutation acceptable as long as names match?
If the DataFrame has a single numeric column, does the normalization scale that column's cumulative sum to [0,1] based on its own min/max?
Should the function raise ValueError if NaN appears in any column, or only in numeric columns? (Non-numeric columns already raise TypeError.)
